verdict.rationale: Floot's llms.txt says it turns a plain-language description into a deployed full-stack app with a React + TypeScript frontend. Its docs say that describing a feature produces endpoints, database tables and screens together, and that projects contain pages, components and backend endpoints querying a managed Postgres database. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that one prompt reliably yields working frontend and backend, and detailed docs on how much backend logic a single prompt generates versus later iterations.
